title_zh: 约好报销审批前补齐逐项收据

scenario.label_zh: 核对报销规则与审批责任
scenario.goal_zh: 确认本次报销适用的费用上限及审批责任，并约定补齐明细后再审批

context_zh: 公司员工向财务同事询问一笔出租车报销。
author: author-phase10-a

sentences.speaker: Leah
sentences.text: Is the forty-pound limit applicable to this taxi trip, or only to journeys inside the city?

sentences.speaker: Tomas
sentences.text: It applies to this trip too. But the card statement doesn't show the individual charges.

sentences.speaker: Leah
sentences.text: I've got the total here. Can't you authorize the payment on that basis?

sentences.speaker: Tomas
sentences.text: I handle approval, but I need an itemized receipt. The audit team must be able to trace each expense.

sentences.speaker: Leah
sentences.text: All right. I'll request one from the taxi company and attach it to the claim.

sentences.speaker: Tomas
sentences.text: Once it's there, I'll review it against the limit. I haven't approved the claim yet.
